title: kiln / Overview
description: kiln CI/CD server: queue, throughput, latency, sources and server health.

panels.title: Queued
panels.description: Jobs waiting for an executor.

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Jobs currently executing.

panels.title: Agents
panels.description: Connected agents (bare metal + job pods).

panels.title: Success ratio (range)
panels.description: Succeeded / (succeeded + failed + timed out) over the selected time range. Cancelled jobs excluded.

panels.title: Jobs finished by status
panels.description: Jobs per minute, stacked by final status.

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Queued vs running jobs.

panels.title: Top failing repos (range)
panels.description: Failed + timed-out jobs per repository over the selected range.

panels.title: Job duration p50 / p90 / p99
panels.description: From job start to finish.

panels.title: Queue wait p50 / p90 / p99
panels.description: From queued to picked up by an executor.

panels.title: Job duration distribution
panels.description: Finished jobs per duration bucket.

panels.title: GitOps polls / min
panels.description: Repository polls by outcome (304 Not Modified is free against the rate limit).

panels.title: Supervisor restarts & caught panics
panels.description: Should be flat zero. Any bar is worth a look at /api/system.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by the server process.

panels.title: Blobs requests
panels.description: Requests to the store kiln keeps its bytes in (docs/blobs.md), by operation and outcome.

panels.title: Blobs latency
panels.description: How long requests to the store took: p50 and p99, by operation.

panels.title: Blobs bytes
panels.description: Bytes written to and read from the store.

panels.title: Blobs refused or unavailable
panels.description: The share of requests refused (a typed refusal: not found, precondition failed, too large, ...) or that the store couldn't answer.

panels.title: Live feed frames
panels.description: Frames sessions' live feeds published on the bus (docs/bus.md), a second.

panels.title: Live feed delivery
panels.description: How long a frame took from its publish to a viewer's read.

panels.title: Live feed lag notices and refusals
panels.description: Viewers told they fell behind a feed and sent back to a snapshot, and what the bus refused a feed, by operation, a second.

panels.title: Bus viewers, topics and memory
panels.description: Viewers reading sessions' live feeds, the topics the bus holds, and the share of its memory its messages take.
